newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Bel-20 index holds 2,500 level at start.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bel-20 index holds 2,500 level at start.

text.p: The Bel-20 share index managed to hold above the 2,500 point level in early trade on Tuesday after breaking above it for the first time on Monday.
Dealers said investors were acutely aware of the fact that valuations were fully stretched by the bourse's record run, but added they did not dare to sell for fear of missing further rallies.
"Economic fundamentals remain good for the bourse. It would take an external element, like a political crisis or a war in the Middle East, to break this trend," one dealer said.
By 0845 GMT the Bel-20 stood 1.08 points higher at 2,505.55.

Glass maker Glaverbel was two percent lower at 5,010, continuing a slide started on June 26. Prior to that, an accelerating rise had lifted the share from 3,200 franc in August 1996 to a high of 5,450 on June 26.
Retailer Colruyt was down 2.77 percent at 19,300 francs after rising 4.75 pct to 19,850 on Monday.
Dealers said the market was waiting for the start of the first-half earnings season at the end of this month to see whether the current high price-earnings levels were warranted by corporate profits.
